description: Save the legal owner (registrant) contact that Replo registers the workspace's domains under: name, email, phone, postal address. buy_domain needs it. The registrar keeps it private (WHOIS privacy), and it replaces any contact saved before, for future purchases only. Ask the person for each field rather than guessing, and use exactly what they give. Then call buy_domain again. Before buying a domain, read the building-sites skill (call skills with name "building-sites").

address2.description: Apartment, suite or unit; null or omitted when there is none.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, such as US.

email.description: The owner's email. The registrar may email it to confirm the contact.

firstName.description: The domain owner's legal first name.

lastName.description: The domain owner's legal last name.

phone.description: The owner's phone in E.164 with a dot after the country code, such as +1.4155550123.

siteId.description: Any site in the workspace, from list_sites. The owner contact is saved once per workspace and used for every domain it buys after this.

state.description: State, province or region, such as CA.

name: set_domain_owner
title: Save the domain owner contact
